question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Garrulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garrulous"** means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** The garrulous neighbor constantly chatted about her garden and pets.
 
 

 
• The word **"Reserved"** refers to someone who is quiet, restrained, or not given to excessive talking. (संकोची)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being part of the group, she remained reserved and preferred listening to others.
 
 

 
• Since "Reserved" is the opposite of "Garrulous," it is the most appropriate antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Reserved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Quit** (छोड़ना): To stop or leave something.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to quit his job to pursue his passion for painting.
 
 
 
 
• **Shy** (शर्मीला): Being nervous or timid in social situations.
 
 
• **Example:** The shy boy hesitated to answer the teacher's question.
 
 
 
 
• **Silent** (चुप): Completely quiet or without sound.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was silent after the announcement of the results.
